purpose: Experiment-calibrated parameter set for sample16 full-domain AC3D SIP workflow.

calibration_strategy.basis: The previous strict Niu-style full-domain run underpredicted real conductivity while overpredicting the positive imaginary-conductivity amplitude. This parameter set separates the DC/background-conduction correction from the polarization-strength correction.
calibration_strategy.do_not_interpret_as: A post-hoc real/imag plotting scale. These values are intended for a new AC3D field solve after short diagnostics.

rationale.solid_conductivity_s_m: Set to 0.0024 S/m as an experiment-calibrated background/leakage term for sample16 rather than the strict Niu mineral-insulator setting. The previous solid=0 run implied an x-direction low-frequency apparent formation factor near 1130, far above the sample16 reference F=54.35.
rationale.surface_conductance_s: Reduced from 1.3e-9 S to 1.5e-10 S because the previous run's positive imaginary-conductivity amplitude was too high while its trend was useful.
rationale.membrane_polarizability_eta0: Reduced from 0.01 to 0.0013, close to the diagnostic positive-imaginary amplitude factor 0.126. This targets polarization strength without changing extracted throat geometry.
rationale.geometry_scales: Keep pore_radius_scale, membrane_length_scale, and membrane_zdc_scale at 1.0 so the run remains tied to pnextract geometry; geometry scaling should remain a separately labeled sensitivity test.

diagnostic_plan.step_1: Run maxwell at 0.1 Hz for directions x, y, and z using this parameter set.
diagnostic_plan.step_2: Choose the direction whose low-frequency real effective conductivity and apparent formation factor best match LKC-16.
diagnostic_plan.step_3: Run all mechanism at representative frequencies 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, and 20000 Hz.
diagnostic_plan.step_4: Only run the full 51-frequency four-mechanism sweep if the diagnostic trend and amplitude are plausible.

base_cli_arguments.sample-label: Sample 16 Grainstone REV topphi3 L500 experiment-calibrated
